implementation: New AHIS expression of established mathematical methods; no imported magnetic-field, fusion or reactor module. Existing AHIS leak, modal, localization, fusion and history modules are reused.
biological_inspiration: Tardigrade survival-state analogy informed preservation-first discussion only. No biological material or CAHS performance claim.
patent_scope: Architecture uses diagnostic sensing with separate protective mechanisms; no legal non-infringement or freedom-to-operate claim.
v4_0_1_hardening: Held-out post-response verification now requires consistency with the executed-command response band across the declared finite uncertainty set. No physical measurement-noise calibration is claimed.
v4_0_2_hardening: Held-out post-response verification now preserves complete predicted response vectors for every declared finite uncertainty scenario and requires the measured vector to be coherent with at least one complete scenario. Mixed-scenario coordinate combinations are rejected. No physical measurement-noise model or continuous uncertainty interpolation is claimed.
